title: GeekMon Modpack
description:

body:
# 🌍 GeekMon

GeekMon Modpack is a custom Cobblemon modpack focused on adventure, exploration, smooth performance, and immersive multiplayer gameplay. Used for the GeekMon Server(in development).

Built around Cobblemon and carefully selected addons, GeekMon delivers a fantasy-inspired experience with improved visuals, enhanced world generation, quality-of-life features, and optimized performance.

---
